acknowledged.description: Management has acknowledged receipt and committed to remediation.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Letter archived after remediation cycle completion.

issue.label: Issue letter
issue.description: Auditor formally issues the management letter.

acknowledge.label: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: Management acknowledges the letter and commits to action.

archive.label: Archive
archive.description: Archive letter after remediation cycle is complete.

Grant.title: Grant
Grant.description: A financial grant or subsidy awarded to an organization under a subsidy scheme (WBSO, BBV, NSO, Tozo). Includes isSISAEligible flag per REQ-SISA-010 to control SiSa report aggregation filtering. Full grant lifecycle (application, disbursement, compliance) is declared by add-shillinq-grant-subsidy-management; this stub adds the SiSa eligibility field.

awardDate.description: Date the grant was formally awarded.

accountingStandard.description: Governmental accounting standard applied (e.g., BBV, RJ290).

isSISAEligible.description: Whether this grant requires Single Information Single Audit compliance per REQ-SISA-010. WBSO and BBV grants are eligible; Tozo and NSO grants are not.

VendorMaster.title: Vendor
VendorMaster.description: Vendor party record for accounts payable. Holds bank IBAN, payment terms, tax registration, and dunning-policy reference for a vendor within a single administration. Per REQ-AP-002.

vendorNumber.description: Stable vendor identifier unique per administration.

iban.description: Default IBAN for outgoing payments to this vendor.

bic.description: BIC/SWIFT code matching the IBAN bank.

paymentTermDays.description: Default payment term in days (auto-sets APInvoice.dueDate on creation).

defaultExpenseAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber for default expense coding on AP invoices.

email.description: Primary contact email for invoice queries.

dunningPolicyId.description: FK to OR dunning-workflow policy record if the extension is stable per ADR-022; else null.

contactRef.description: FK to OR contact abstraction if stable per ADR-022; else null. Resolution deferred to implementing cycle.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this vendor record.

lifecycleState.description: Vendor master lifecycle state. blocked: payments suspended; archived: historical reference only.

active.label: Active
active.description: Vendor is active; AP invoices may be created and paid.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Vendor is blocked; new AP invoices cannot transition to approved or posted.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Vendor is archived for historical reference; no new invoices may be created.

archive.label: Archive vendor
archive.description: Archive vendor after all open AP invoices are settled.

APInvoice.title: AP Invoice
APInvoice.description: Accounts payable sub-ledger invoice recording vendor billing and payment obligation. Posting materialises a balanced GLTransaction per T1 REQ-JE-007. Lifecycle: draft → pending → approved → posted → paid with disputed/voided branches. Approval routing consumes OR approval-workflow per ADR-022. Per REQ-AP-003 and REQ-AP-004.

vendorInvoiceRef.description: The vendor's own invoice number as it appears on the paper/PDF invoice.

dueDate.description: Auto-calculated from invoiceDate + vendor.paymentTermDays; overrideable by operator.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. T2: base currency only; T5 adds multi-currency.

totalAmount.description: Total amount including tax. Credit notes are separate journal types, not negative totals.

taxAmount.description: VAT/BTW amount. T3 adds automated VAT posting; T2 carries the field for reporting.

lines.description: Invoice line breakdown. Each line maps to one GL expense account.

taxCode.description: Tax code for this line (e.g. BTW21, BTW9, BTW0).

quantity.description: Quantity ordered/received (required for 3-way match when PO/GR present).

unitPrice.description: Unit price (required for 3-way match quantity parity check).

sourceDocumentUri.description: docudesk FK URI per bookkeeping-document-attachment-integration. Points to the scanned vendor invoice PDF.

purchaseOrderRef.description: FK to PO register UUID (future T4 procurement; nullable in T2). Declared so T4 attaches additively per REQ-AP-006.

goodsReceiptRef.description: FK to Goods Receipt register UUID (future T4; nullable in T2). Declared so T4 attaches additively per REQ-AP-006.

approvalState.description: OR approval-workflow state mirror per REQ-AP-005. Tracks the approval routing status.

state.description: AP invoice lifecycle state per REQ-AP-004.

glTransactionId.description: Back-reference to the materialised GLTransaction once the invoice is posted.

idealLink.description: Per-invoice iDEAL payment link (x-openregister-calculations output per REQ-AP-007). Populated when paymentMethod=ideal.

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod for GL posting (resolved on post transition per REQ-AP-004).

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this AP invoice.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Under construction. Lines and header fields may be edited.

pending.label: Pending approval
pending.description: Submitted for approval. Awaiting OR approval-workflow decision.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Approved by authorised approver(s). Ready for posting.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Immutable. GL transaction materialised. Awaiting payment matching.

paid.label: Paid
paid.description: Full payment matched via bank reconciliation or PaymentRun.

disputed.label: Disputed
disputed.description: Payment held; under investigation. Operator records investigation note.

voided.label: Voided
voided.description: Voided. Corresponding GLTransaction must already be reversed.

submit.label: Submit for approval
submit.description: Operator submits the draft invoice for approval routing via OR approval-workflow per REQ-AP-005.

approve.label: Approve
approve.description: Approved by authorised approver(s) via OR approval-workflow. Sets approvalState: approved.

reject.label: Reject (return to draft)
reject.description: Approver rejects; sets approvalState: rejected and returns invoice to draft for operator revision.

post.label: Post
post.description: Post the invoice. Guards: (1) 3-way match per REQ-AP-006 (conditional on PO/GR presence); (2) FiscalPeriod open per REQ-PC-004. Action: materialise balanced GLTransaction per T1 REQ-JE-007 pattern.

actions.description: Emit one balanced GLTransaction with debit to expense accounts per lines and credit to AP control account (Account.isAPControlAccount = true) per T1 REQ-JE-007 pattern. Sets glTransactionId back-reference.

matchPaid.label: Mark as paid
matchPaid.description: Transition to paid when bank-reconciliation engine matches an exact-amount bank statement line per REQ-AP-008. No shillinq matcher service — OR event-driven.

dispute.label: Raise dispute
dispute.description: Operator places payment hold pending investigation.

resolveDispute.label: Resolve dispute
resolveDispute.description: Operator resolves dispute; invoice returns to posted awaiting payment.

void.label: Void
void.description: Void a posted invoice. Guard: the materialised GLTransaction MUST already be reversed per T1 REQ-GL-004.

idealLink.expression: ideal.generatePaymentLink({invoiceNumber: invoiceNumber, amount: totalAmount, currency: currency, vendorRef: vendorInvoiceRef})
idealLink.description: Per-invoice iDEAL payment link generated by the OR calculations engine per REQ-AP-007. Populated automatically when the invoice is included in a PaymentRun with paymentMethod=ideal.

apAging.label: AP Aging
apAging.description: Groups open AP invoices by vendor and aging bucket per REQ-AP-009. Excludes paid and voided invoices.

PaymentRun.title: Payment Run
PaymentRun.description: Operator-curated batch of selected APInvoice UUIDs with SEPA pain.001 XML and iDEAL link outputs generated as x-openregister-calculations fields. No PaymentRunService or SepaXmlBuilder PHP classes per ADR-031. Per REQ-AP-007.

runNumber.description: Sequential payment run identifier per administration.

invoiceRefs.description: List of APInvoice UUIDs to include in this payment run.

totalAmount.description: Sum of selected invoices' totalAmount (x-openregister-calculations output).

paymentMethod.description: Payment method for this run. Determines which calculation output is populated.

sepaXml.description: SEPA pain.001.001.03 XML document (x-openregister-calculations output per REQ-AP-007). Populated when paymentMethod=sepa-pain001. Operator downloads and uploads to bank portal.

idealLinks.description: Per-invoice iDEAL payment links (x-openregister-calculations output per REQ-AP-007). Populated when paymentMethod=ideal.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this payment run.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Operator selects invoices and configures the run.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: SEPA XML or iDEAL links generated. Ready for download / submission.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Operator has uploaded the SEPA file or shared iDEAL links.

failed.label: Failed
failed.description: Run failed (e.g. bank rejection). Operator must investigate and retry.

prepare.label: Generate payment file
prepare.description: Triggers x-openregister-calculations to compose sepaXml (pain.001.001.03) or idealLinks per paymentMethod selection.

submit.label: Mark as submitted
submit.description: Operator confirms upload to bank portal or dispatch of iDEAL links.

execute.label: Mark as executed
execute.description: Bank confirms payment execution (or bank reconciliation auto-matches).

fail.label: Mark as failed
fail.description: Bank rejects the payment file or iDEAL transaction.

retry.label: Retry (return to draft)
retry.description: Return to draft for operator to correct and re-generate.

totalAmount.description: Sum of selected APInvoice totals, computed on save per REQ-AP-007.

sepaXml.expression: sepa.composePain001({invoiceRefs: invoiceRefs, runDate: runDate, schemaVersion: 'pain.001.001.03', administrationId: administrationId})
sepaXml.description: SEPA pain.001.001.03 XML document composed from selected invoice vendor IBANs, amounts, and run date per REQ-AP-007. Populated when paymentMethod=sepa-pain001.

idealLinks.expression: invoiceRefs.map(id => ideal.generatePaymentLink({invoiceRef: id, amount: APInvoice[id].totalAmount, currency: APInvoice[id].currency}))
idealLinks.description: Per-invoice iDEAL payment link array per REQ-AP-007. Populated when paymentMethod=ideal.

iv3-xml-transformation.name: IV3 XML Transformation
iv3-xml-transformation.description: Maps an Iv3Export record (with aggregated buckets) to the CBS IV3-bestand XML structure. ADR-031 declarative path — preferred over a PHP renderer. If OR's mapping engine cannot express CBS mixed-content XML nodes, the Iv3XmlRenderer::render() exception path (documented in openspec/changes/add-shillinq-iv3-reporting/design.md §D3) applies.

objects.name: Bank Transaction Polling
objects.description: Periodic polling workflow that calls the openconnector PSD2 aggregator source by slug, normalises aggregator JSON to CAMT.053 format, attaches the document via docudesk, and creates BankStatement records. Runs 4× daily per REQ-BC-004 + ADR-031 path 2. No shillinq-side TimedJob.

objects.findingDescription: BTW-afdracht over Q3 2025 niet tijdig ingediend bij de Belastingdienst. Achterstalling van €18.500 geconstateerd in boeking 4320.
Inkoopopdrachten boven €25.000 zonder formele aanbestedingsprocedure (6 gevallen, totaal €187.000).
objects.observationDescription: Aanbeveling: implementeer automatische drempelwaarde-controle in inkoopsysteem voor orders boven €10.000.

objects.findingDescription: Tekenbevoegdheid overschreden: factuur van €450.000 getekend door functionaris zonder mandaat voor bedragen boven €100.000 (REQ-SISA-004 handtekeningbevoegdheid).

objects.findingsSummary: Twee majeure bevindingen aangetroffen: (1) BTW-afdracht Q3 2025 niet tijdig ingediend; (2) inkoopopdrachten zonder aanbestedingsprocedure. Geen kritieke bevindingen.
objects.observationsSummary: Aanbeveling versterking inkoopproces voor drempelwaarden boven €10.000.
objects.remediationRecommendations: 1. Herstel BTW-aangifte Q3 2025 vóór 30 juni 2026. 2. Implementeer automatische drempelwaarde-controle. 3. Train inkoopmedewerkers op aanbestedingsregels.

objects.findingsSummary: Kritieke bevinding: overschrijding tekenbevoegdheid (€450.000 zonder mandaat). Herstel niet tijdig afgerond — remediëring verloopt.
objects.observationsSummary: Drie governance-observaties t.a.v. inkoopproces, budgetbeheer en periodieke mandaatcontroles.
objects.remediationRecommendations: 1. Onmiddellijk mandaatregister actualiseren. 2. Terugbetalingsregeling treffen voor bedrag boven mandaat. 3. Kwartaalcontrole op tekenbevoegdheden implementeren.
